text:
lina: Quick heads-up — I moved the new model weights to s3://redwood-models/llama-mini-8b/v1/weights.tar.gz and pushed an onboarding config to the repo. Noticed weirdness when running the chat template: sometimes replies include an extra leading "" token and EOS isn't consistently appended. Can folks glance at tokenizer config and the prompt wrapper?

ev an: which wrapper are you using — the `chat_assistant_v2` template?

lina: yes, chat_assistant_v2 in `models/llama-mini-8b/onboard.yaml`. Also saw that when we call the runtime with `stop=["
", "</s>"]` the model still emits `</s>` but sometimes duplicates BOS at start of assistant content.

jas: weird — could be two things: (1) tokenizer special tokens mapping different between tokenizers (some use `` as internal sentinel), (2) prompt preprocessor double-inserting BOS. Do you have the prompt payload?

lina: pasted the payload we used in repro run: ```json
{"messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Explain delta between A and B."}],"template":"chat_assistant_v2","max_tokens":256}```

marta: thanks. quick check — on my local when I instantiate the tokenizer from the weights bundle, `tokenizer.bos_token` is set to `"<s>"`, `eos_token` is `"</s>"`, but `unk_token` is `""` (legacy). That `unk_token` value can confuse some prompt builders if they do naive joins.

ken: @lina can you point to the exact repo commit? I'll run the onboard CI token-checker.

lina: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/commit/ae3f9c2 (onboard.yaml & wrapper change). I added `token_mapping: auto` in the config to let our loader guess specials.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline queued for commit ae3f9c2 — tokenizer-sanity-check, model-validate, integration-tests.

jas: if `token_mapping: auto` is in play, the loader might map unknown specials to `` as placeholder. Suggest explicitly set `special_tokens` in `onboard.yaml` to avoid heuristics. e.g.:

```yaml
special_tokens:
  bos_token: "<s>"
  eos_token: "</s>"
  pad_token: "<pad>"
  unk_token: "<unk>"
```

fiona: also check the chat template code path — we had a subtle bug where the template prepends `bos_token` for assistant messages and then the runtime's `encode_prompt` also prepended it. Double prepend => leading extra token. I filed an internal note: https://redwood-internal/notes/ML-3451

lina: ok will change config to explicit specials and remove the extra prepend in the wrapper (PR incoming). Anything else to validate before I push?

ken: run `scripts/token_check.sh s3://redwood-models/llama-mini-8b/v1/weights.tar.gz` — it prints mapping and a short sample encoding. If you see `0: <s>` and then `1: <s>` (duplicate mapping) that's a red flag.

marta: another gotcha: when using streaming, our prefix-caching path expects `eos_token` to be appended only when generation ends. If both the prompt builder and the runtime append EOS you'll see duplicate `</s>` tokens at tail. So check `onboard.yaml` `append_eos: false` if the runtime handles it.

lina: noted. I'll update `onboard.yaml` to explicit specials and set `append_eos: false`, submit PR, and ping for review. ETA ~2h. Thanks all :pray:

evan: ping @jas and @ken for quick CR when PR is up. Happy to run the integration test matrix once config lands. :thumbsup:

marta: good plan. small reminder: add a unit test that encodes the canonical prompt and asserts `tokens[0] != ''` and `tokens[-1] == '</s>'` in CI to catch regressions.

lina: added note in PR description. I'll drop the test in too.

deploy-bot: PR #412 queued for CI (tokenizer-sanity-check).

ken: thanks, everyone. If CI is green, we can flip the model to staging and run a small traffic test.

lina: perfect — I'll follow up here with results.
